creator: Alexander Terp
description:
suite.go holds the public Suite/Input/Action/Output/Markers declarations and the
private schema() validation together. Every other file in the package owns one
concern - case.go types, eval.go pure compare, run.go orchestration, the format
layer split four ways.

Cosmetic, and worth doing only when suite.go is being touched anyway. Filed so
the inconsistency is recorded rather than rediscovered.
title: Split suite.go into types and schema compilation
